FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: US CPI Fuels Fed Hike Odds, Technical Rebound Anticipated
tldr_points: US CPI data raises Fed rate‑hike probability, supporting USD strength.
RSI at 23.1 indicates deep oversold condition, suggesting a near‑term bounce.
Price sits below MA20 (157.82), offering a clear upside target on a mean‑reversion move.
FX.excerpt: US CPI fuels Fed hike odds, lifting USD/JPY from oversold 153.55 toward MA20 157.82 despite RSI weakness.
FX.comment: Oversold RSI and bullish Fed outlook support a short‑term rebound toward MA20 resistance.
